summary: @arv-bedrock/auth-admin preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line file with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (function `WV8StW` cycling numeric/character array `n7gIxM` through a decoder `hc1jfK9`), so its behavior is not inspectable without execution. Using a freshly-downloaded alternate interpreter to run an opaque bundled blob at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and evades scanners that only trace Node-resolved code. The advertised purpose (an auth admin SDK) provides no legitimate need for a downloaded runtime or an obfuscated multi-hundred-kilobyte install-time script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
